paragraphs.text: Duel Masters is a trading card game made by the Wizards of the Coast and distributed by Takara Tomy . In Japan, it is often known as DM as well as デュエマ ( Duema ) .

While it is seldom played in Western countries due to the English game being discontinued, in Japan it is recognized as one of the three major trading card games alongside the Pokémon Trading Card Game and the Yu-Gi-Oh! OCG .

The card game was first released in Japan on May 30, 2002, and on March 5th, 2004, in America. In November 2006, the last set of the English Game was released, and the game was discontinued. It was later rebooted as Kaijudo in June 2012, but it was again discontinued in September 2014. The Japanese game is currently the only version in production.
While its originality is now established, it had many concepts that came from Magic: The Gathering , such as:
Clash --> Gachinko Judge

On the other hand, there are reverse inspirations, such as Turbo Rush becoming Frenzy . Not all abilities that work in Magic: The Gathering work as well in Duel Masters however, so players should be warned.

Duel Masters features Collaboration Cards: cards designed in collaboration with other non-Duel Masters copyrighted franchises. Each of these cards based on Magic: The Gathering cards have been printed in Duel Masters .:
91 Emrakul, the Aeons Torn
199 Mons's Goblin Raiders
105 Jace, the Mind Sculptor
164 Mitzy, Guardian of Development Department

The The BAD Thanksgiving Charisma BEST DM26-EX2 set (2026) features the character of Crysta on two new alternative art 'Treasure' treatment printings for Emrakul.
PR1/PR10, PR1秘/PR10 — Emrakul, the Aeons Torn

Fabulous Art is a series of alternate artwork reprints, similar to Magic: The Gathering 's Secret Lair . These two 2026 releases feature cards in an MTG-based card frame , using artists and flavor text from Magic .
"Invitation to Dominaria" Duel Masters creatures as they would appear on Dominaria .
"You are a Planeswalker" Duel Masters spells with Planeswalkers appearing on them.

In 2023, Friday Night Magic Japan featured four foil crossover promos with Duel Masters art, available September-December. The art for these cards was previously used in the DMEX-18 set of Duel Masters .
